dolomites-sella-ronda-overnight-scout.title: Dolomites Sella Ronda Overnight Scout
dolomites-sella-ronda-overnight-scout.slogan: 4 passes in 618 km, topping out at 2239 m
dolomites-sella-ronda-overnight-scout.story: World-class passes, but only with a night away. 618 km round from Chur - plan on about 11 h 53 of riding. The climbs: Ofenpass approach, Pordoi Pass, Campolongo Pass and Gardena Pass. It tops out at 2,239 m. It crosses from Switzerland into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The passes are the reason to go.

waypoints.name: Ofenpass approach
waypoints.advice: You top out at 2149 m here. The road climbs 1556 m on the way up to it, steadily. Reckon on about 10 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. At this height the road is a summer one: snow gates can stay shut into June and shut again in October. Next is Pordoi Pass.

waypoints.name: Pordoi Pass
waypoints.advice: 2239 m, and the road stops climbing. Reckon on about 11 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Campolongo Pass, mostly downhill.
waypoints.imageAudit: OK: v2.3 waypoint query is tied to route and local waypoint name

waypoints.name: Campolongo Pass
waypoints.advice: The high point of this section, 1875 m up. You lose 364 m on the way down to it, steadily. Reckon on about 8 °C colder than the valley, and more in the wind. High enough to hold ice in the shaded corners early and late in the year. Next is Gardena Pass, climbing 261 m.

sections.advice: Use Chur eastbound gate → Ofenpass approach as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

This Ofenpass approach → Pordoi Pass stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Timmelsjoch High Alpine Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Height already gained and held. The road stays near 2239 m for 197 km instead of surrendering it to the next valley. Exposed ground: wind matters more here than gradient. Nothing blocks it.

scenicChapters.title: Great Dolomites Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it. The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 2136 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Stelvio Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: 285 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

dolomites-sella-ronda-overnight-scout.storyWas: World-class passes, but only with a night away.

scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 65 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-la-saunerie-chapelle-notre-dame-d.story: From Peseux it runs 346 km to Peseux; allow about 5 h 58 of riding. It goes by way of Forêt de la Bettlachstock, Chapelle Notre-Dame-du-Haut de Ronchamp and back through Forêt de la Bettlachstock. It crosses from Switzerland into France - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The line favours views over speed.
